description: Mines of the Russian Empire (1820s) is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Kelly O'Neill. Mines of the Russian Empire, as depicted on the Geographical Atlas of the Russian Empire produced by the Military-Topographical Depot of His Imperial Majesty's General Staff, 1820-1827. Component of the Imperiia Project. Documentation and analysis available here (http://dighist.fas.harvard.edu/projects/imperiia/items/show/667). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2016. Formats: XML, ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (the dataset page says only that it "is made available with limited information on how it can be used"). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
